arm_meaning.B: endpoint plus frozen Transformer state-action predictions
arm_meaning.C: endpoint plus measured single-action conventional continuation values, separately costed

protocol.ensemble: equal arithmetic mean; existing stage2 checkpoints; no weight or seed tuning in this experiment
protocol.parent_selection: minimum real mean discovery gap; strict improvement, earlier parent wins ties
protocol.program_selection: four unique elites by real discovery gap including eligible initial; select by real program_select gap, earlier wins ties
protocol.candidate_failures_duplicates: each consumes one output; no free retries; exact program/pool/seed cache reuse explicit; behavioral duplicates recorded
protocol.prompt_common: same program interface and endpoint fields; show up to eight previous expressions/outcomes to discourage repeats, no auxiliary values in A
protocol.auxiliary_selection: largest absolute same-state child-minus-parent value; stable bank-id ties
protocol.B_uncertainty: across-model std is displayed only as optimization variation; no calibrated confidence claim; abs delta <= max(.001,std) gets no indicated preference
protocol.C_value_scope: one exact conditional rollout for each current edge, common RNG seed71, conventional subsequent rule, fixed H; not an expectation estimate or optimal Q; zero true differences produce no preference
protocol.C_cost: precompute all current-edge rollouts including reference once; reuse across all parent-child decisions; count all branches and bank inference separately
protocol.protocol_adaptation: no setting, checkpoint, horizon, threshold, or prompt change based on this experiment's outcomes; no adaptive output expansion
protocol.interpretation: Four paired discovery repetitions are preliminary. C vs A tests utility of measured finite-horizon information; C vs B helps localize teacher error. No significance/success from a favorable single seed. Subsequent method changes require a new protocol and fresh evaluation holdout.
